summary.text: Janet Ellis is a Democratic member of the Montana State Senate, District 41, who is not seeking re-election to the Senate and is instead a candidate for Montana House of Representatives District 81 on November 3, 2026.
She previously represented House District 81 from 2015 to 2019 and works as a program director with Montana Audubon.

paragraphs.text: Ellis earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Montana, and her listed profession is program director with Montana Audubon.
She served in the Montana House of Representatives, District 81, from 2015 to 2019, and Democrat Mary Caferro succeeded her in that seat.
Ellis won State Senate District 41 in 2018 and was re-elected in 2022, and she has served in the Senate since January 7, 2019.
For 2025-2026 Ellis is vice chair of the Senate Finance and Claims Committee and a member of the Senate State Administration Committee.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary for House District 81.
